instruction: A candid medium-shot documentary photograph in a bright workshop. On the left, the smiling young man with an afro in a grey shirt (R2) shakes hands with the smiling young man with dark curly hair in a plaid flannel shirt (R1) on the right. R1 holds a smartphone in his left hand. A wooden bird sculpture sits on the table between them in the foreground. The room is brightly lit with soft, natural light coming from the windows, creating a warm and friendly atmosphere.
